name: Proposal Hosting Plan Terms
description: In the Investment section of the public proposal (/proposal/:uuid) the current hosting offer shows exactly three payment-frequency tiers (every 9 months 40% / semiannual 20% / quarterly 10%; monthly and annual are not offered) and a free-hosting-month gift bucket whose title reflects the real count ('1 mes' / 'N meses'). The bucket is gated by the explicit hostingPlan.freeMonthsVisible checkbox, NOT by the count being non-zero; content saved before that flag existed falls back to the old rule (count > 0) so historical proposals look unchanged. The public API and downloadable PDF share the same normalized terms — including the free-month copy, which the backend fills with a per-language default when the operator leaves it empty — in Spanish and English. Closed or inactive proposals preserve their stored historical tiers. The renewal conditions (for each renewal year from the second year the cost grows by Colombian SMLMV increase % + a fixed 8% over the previous year) render ONLY in the downloadable PDF, NOT in the web view.
knownGaps: The dedicated Playwright spec covers the Spanish public path; English labels and PDF pricing are covered by focused backend/unit tests rather than a second E2E variant.
The PDF side of the visibility checkbox is covered by backend tests (test_proposal_pdf_free_months.py), not by an E2E download assertion.
